text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and I are on our way back
from buying
new cleats.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, I remember that shop...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sure brings back memories. Working
there was
pretty fun.
choice_data_list: That's the regional shop you helpe...
That's the regional shop you helpe...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Umm, excuse me... Are you by any
chance Oguri
Cap?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh... Um, yes...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We're huge fans—always cheering for
you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, ummm...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm happy to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Your support really means a lot. So...
thank you
for cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Of course! And thanks for always being
so
inspiring!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Good luck in all your future races!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Right. Thank you again for your
support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might still be slightly awkward, but
Oguri Cap
is much more relaxed when it
comes to interacting
with her fans now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keeping you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keeping you waiting.
choice_data_list: All that practice paid off, huh.
All that practice paid off, didn't it?
You've grown another step, haven't...
You've grown another step, haven't...
Getting used to being surrounded b...
Getting used to being surrounded b...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It's all thanks to you.
choice_data_list: All that practice paid off, huh.
All that practice paid off, didn't it?
You've grown another step, haven't...
You've grown another step, haven't...
Getting used to being surrounded b...
Getting used to being surrounded b...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If not for your advice, I don't know if I
would've
been able to talk to my fans at
all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Having you by my side gave me the
confidence I
needed. I really appreciate
it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, I told Tama about how I
helped out at
that store.
choice_data_list: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And guess what she said? She called you
"Poppa
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And guess what she said? She called you
"Momma
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Should I call you "Poppa" from now
on?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Should I call you "Momma" from now
on?
choice_data_list: P-Please, just keep calling me Tra...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling pleased that Oguri Cap has
placed so
much trust in me, we start
making our way back.
choice_data_list: P-Please, just keep calling me Tra...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I have? Heh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You sounded like Shige just now.
choice_data_list: Something wrong?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You sounded like Tome just now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I always found it strange how I feel so
calm
talking to you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I think I know why. You remind me
of
Shige—actually, no... You remind me
of home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I think I know why. You remind me
of
Tome—actually, no... You remind me
of home.
choice_data_list: Similar how—in their vibe?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'd love for you to visit my
hometown one
day. I'm sure you'd like it.
choice_data_list: Similar how—in their vibe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm flooded with pride for how far Oguri
Cap has come—not just in her racing,
but as a person. If
only everyone else
could witness this moment.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm still working on it, but I think
I've made
some good progress. Hey, do
you mind if I ask
you something?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I ever need any more advice, do you
think it'd
be okay for me to come to
you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. I'm glad to know that I can
rely on you
for more than just racing.
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reminded of our undeniable bond, the
two of us
begin making our way back.
